Your missionResponsibilities
• Design, plan, and execute research activities within early and advanced projects, e.g analysis and interpretation of data to support target validation and candidate profiling – including benchwork as needed
• Provide guidance and functional leadership to technicians, including supervision of experimental work
• Identify scientific challenges and propose solutions or alternative approaches
• Integrate internal and external data (e.g. literature, databases, experimental results) to generate insights supporting project decisions
• Initiate and coordinate research collaborations with academic partners, CROs, and external experts
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (e.g. research, clinical, regulatory) to ensure alignment of activities with project goals
• Contribute to the evaluation of external opportunities, including participation in due diligence activities
• Support resource planning and coordination of activities within assigned projects
• Present data in internal and external meetings and conferences as a speaker and representative of AiCuris
• Prepare and contribute to scientific documents, including research reports, publications, patents, and regulatory documents

Your profileSkills and Qualification
• Education : PhD in (Molecular) Virology or a related discipline, with at least 2 years of experience in antiviral research and/or drug discovery within an academic or industry-based virology laboratory
• In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with virology laboratory methods and technologies
• Ability to design and conduct experiments to address project relevant questions based on relevant scientific and patent literature
• Hands-on experience relevant state of the art scientific software, including sequence analysis and scientific data analysis software, such as Geneious Prime and GraphPad Prism, or comparable tools
• Strong commitment to scientific rigor, data integrity, and thorough documentation of experimental work
• Proven ability to independently manage research projects and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams, while providing scientific guidance, mentoring, and technical support to laboratory staff
• Willingness to learn and apply regulatory (GCP/GLP/GMP, FDA/EMA regulations) and quality assurance (QA) requirements into work practices as needed.
• Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex tasks. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Very good communication skills with the ability to present complex data clearly. Collaborative team player with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. High level of personal motivation and ownership
• Languages: Excellent written and verbal English; in addition, German language skills (at least B1 level) are considered essential, as the role involves regular interaction with technicians who may prefer communication in German.

Why us?What we offer
• Unique corporate culture: Scientific excellence, a collaborative working environment and the passion to improve the lives of patients defines our work. With us, you can work together with innovation awarded experts with the proven ability to translate science into commercial success. You can expect diversity, inspiration as well as trustful collaboration.
• Development: We encourage people to grow and strongly support individual development and learning opportunities.
• Flexibility: Embracing flexible working accommodations, we enable our people to integrate business into their personal life.
• Benefits: Employer-funded pension comes along with an attractive benefits package

About usAiCuris is meeting the needs of the growing population of immunocompromised people who require precise therapies to effectively treat infection. Our flagship product, PREVYMIS, marketed by our partner MSD, treats CMV in a defined group of transplant recipients. Our pivotal phase 3 candidate Pritelivir aims to address recurrent and resistant HSV infections in a broad population of patients with weakened immune systems. For immunocompromised people, an otherwise manageable infection can mean life or death. AiCuris, with its expertise and growing pipeline, is committed to providing therapeutic solutions for them now and in the future.We believe in a culture of trust and transparency, where feedback is considered an opportunity to contribute to each other's personal and professional growth. We hire people who are collaborative, adaptable, communicate well, and love to learn.
*AiCuris is an employer that supports equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people regardless of their national origin, skin color, religion, gender, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
Tasks & responsibilities

- Design and prepare clinical development plans, focusing on Phase I, II, and III in oncology indications.
- Guide cross-functional teams as the clinical lead, including experts from clinical trial operations, regulatory, medical affairs, preclinical & clinical pharmacology, biostatistics, biomarkers, and patient safety to ensure high-quality execution.
- Oversee the setup, conduct, and data readout of clinical trials together with the Clinical Trial Lead, ensuring timelines, quality, and ethical standards are met.
- Provide input to regulatory strategy and clinical components of briefing documents, presentations, and responses to regulatory questions.
- Contribute to the Medical Affairs strategy and deliverables, such as the Integrated Evidence Plan, in collaboration with Medical Advisor(s) and the Medical Affairs Lead.
- Evaluate external opportunities using your clinical expertise to support decisions that strengthen the pipeline.

Additional tasks for the Senior Role:

- Supervise and mentor other Clinical Program Leads in the assigned program/asset.
- Shape the overarching development strategy for the program in alignment with Indication and Brand Teams, including marketing and market access.
- Initiate external collaborations with academic and industrial partners.

Requirements

- MD degree with several years of clinical and scientific experience in oncology
- Few years of experience in clinical drug development within the pharmaceutical industry or equivalent experience in academic clinical research
- Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups
- Skilled in presenting scientific content and facilitating cross-functional discussions
- High level of initiative, strategic thinking, and team orientation
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Additional requirements for the Senior Role:

- MD degree with long-standing clinical and scientific experience in oncology
- Several years of experience in clinical drug development within the pharmaceutical industry or equivalent experience in academic clinical research
- Strong Leadership skills with the ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.

Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until October 31, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.
Step 2: Virtual meeting mid of September
Step 3: Panel interviews end of September
Please submit your application documents in English.

Your missionAs a Project Manager PV/BESS you will support the delivery of utility-scale Solar PV and BESS projects across Germany. The role will focus on owner-side project execution and EPC oversight from pre-NTP through construction, commissioning, COD, and handover to operations.

You will coordinate EPC contractors, technical advisors, site management, HSE consultants, grid stakeholders, and internal delivery teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the expected technical and quality standards.

Projects will typically range from 20 MW to 100 MW and include PV+BESS hybrid systems with predominantly MV but also HV grid connection scope.

The role is remote/home-office based within Germany with regular travel to project sites as required.

Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Coordination
• Manage utility-scale PV and PV+BESS projects during pre-construction, construction, commissioning, COD, and operational handover phases.
• Coordinate owner-side project execution activities across internal and external stakeholders.
• Ensure project delivery in accordance with schedule, budget, quality, HSE, contractual, and lender expectations.
• Support transition from development to execution phase, including pre-NTP readiness activities.

EPC & Contractor Management
• Act as primary owner-side interface toward EPC contractors and key project consultants.
• Monitor contractor performance, schedule adherence, construction progress, and execution quality.
• Track contractual obligations, risks, variations, and claims in coordination with internal legal and management teams.

Technical & Advisor Coordination
• Coordinate external technical advisors, owner’s engineers, HSE consultants, commissioning specialists, and other technical stakeholders.
• Coordinate commissioning, performance testing, punch-list management, and COD activities.
• Support grid connection coordination together with external specialists and EPC contractors.

Construction & Site Coordination
• Coordinate site managers, HSE consultants, commissioning teams, and O&M stakeholders during execution.
• Conduct regular site visits during active construction and critical project phases.
• Monitor construction progress, interface management, quality issues, and project risks.

Commercial & Reporting Responsibilities
• Maintain project schedules, risk registers, action trackers, and reporting structures.
• Support budget monitoring and change-order tracking.
• Prepare project updates and reporting for senior management and internal stakeholders.

Operational Handover
• Coordinate project close-out, warranty management, defect resolution, and handover to asset management teams and investors.
• Support establishment of stable operational interfaces with O&M providers and operational stakeholders.

Your profileProfessional Experience
• Minimum 8 years of professional experience in utility-scale solar PV project delivery, thereof at least 3 years as main responsible project manager.
• Proven experience delivering at least 5 utility-scale PV projects to COD in Germany.
• Experience with PV+BESS hybrid projects is mandatory.
• Experience working on owner-side, EPC-side, or integrated developer/EPC delivery models.
• Exposure to EPCm, multi-contracting, or free-issue equipment models considered advantageous.
• Experience with MV grid connection projects required; HV/substation experience considered a plus.

Technical & Commercial Competencies
• Strong understanding of utility-scale PV construction and commissioning processes.
• Good understanding of project delivery interfaces including EPC contractors, technical advisors, grid operators, HSE, commissioning, and O&M stakeholders.
• Basic understanding of SCADA/PPC systems, EMS/BESS integration, protection systems and commissioning and performance testing.
• Familiarity with German grid connection processes, DSO coordination, and grid-code related execution topics considered advantageous.
• Experience with project schedule management, risk management, contractor coordination, and construction reporting.
• Familiarity with German permitting and environmental compliance processes.

Education & Background

Language Requirements

Personal Profile

• High professional standards and strong commitment to project success and delivery quality.

Why us?

Woolpert is an award‑winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting‑edge technology to deliver exceptional client value, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, we embrace progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth.  

As part of Woolpert, Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company contributes deep geospatial expertise across Europe, supporting complex infrastructure, property, manufacturing, utilities, and natural‑environment projects through world‑class data capture, verification, and governance.  

Position Overview 

Murphy Geospatial, a Woolpert company, is seeking a Reality Capture Technician to support a major semiconductor manufacturing project in Dresden.

This role is primarily focused on the processing, registration, QA/QC, and management of terrestrial laser scan data captured across a large-scale construction environment. Working as part of our Special Projects team, you will help transform field-captured data into accurate, actionable information that supports construction delivery, quality assurance, and project reporting. 

This opportunity would suit candidates from a laser scanning, geomatics, surveying, reality capture, digital construction, or BIM background who are looking to develop their expertise on a high-profile international project.

What You Will Do 

- Process terrestrial laser scan data captured by project survey teams. 
- Register, align, and quality-check point cloud datasets.
- Identify and resolve point cloud registration and data quality issues.
- Prepare structured point cloud deliverables for project stakeholders.
- Support construction verification and design versus as-built assessments.
- Produce reports, visual outputs, and technical documentation.
- Maintain organised project datasets and reporting trackers.
- Collaborate with surveying, BIM, and construction teams to support project delivery.

Technology You'll Work With

- Leica Cyclone / Cyclone 3DR
- CloudCompare
- ClearEdge Verity
- Autodesk Revit
- Navisworks
- Power BI
- Advanced terrestrial laser scanning technologies

What You Will Bring 

Essential:

- Experience processing terrestrial laser scan data and point clouds. 
- Experience with point cloud registration and QA/QC workflows.
- Experience using software such as Leica Cyclone, CloudCompare, Faro Scene, Trimble RealWorks, or similar.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
- Fluent English.
- Full right to work in Germany.

Desirable:

- Experience working with BIM models.
- Experience in scan-to-model or construction verification workflows.
- Experience on semiconductor, industrial, pharmaceutical, or data centre projects.
- Knowledge of Revit, Navisworks, or Power BI.

Benefits You Will Love 

At Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company, you’ll join a collaborative and innovative team where your expertise makes a real impact. Our benefits include: 

- Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package aligned to your experience 
- Access to cutting‑edge geospatial technology and industry‑leading tools

jobs.occupation: 176/2026 Junior Group Leader (m/f/d) in Computational Multiphase Flow (Ingenieur/in - Verfahrenstechnik)
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Process and Systems Engineering, Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering seeks to fill the following vacancy:

Junior Group Leader (m/f/d) in Computational Multiphase Flow

Salary scale:
13 TV-L

Date commencing:
As soon as possible

Fixed term:
3 years*

Contract status:
100 %

At the Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering (www.mvt.ovgu.de), we are a group of enthusiastic researchers with extensive research activities in the numerical modelling of multiphase flows. Our work addresses the fundamental physical mechanisms governing dispersed and interfacial multiphase flows, as well as their application to engineering systems. Current research topics include particle-laden and droplet-laden turbulent flows, particle–turbulence and droplet–turbulence interactions, the dynamics of non-spherical particles, interfacial flows, and compressible and incompressible multiphase-flow applications. Approximately eight PhD researchers and three postdoctoral researchers currently work in this area at the Chair.

The objective of the advertised position is to attract a junior group leader who will take a leading role in our computational multiphase-flow research. The successful candidate will contribute to and help coordinate ongoing research projects, while also establishing their own research direction within the Chair. The position offers excellent opportunities to develop an independent academic profile and to pursue a Habilitation. It therefore combines scientific leadership in existing activities with the opportunity to initiate new research topics and contribute to the further development of our numerical methods and simulation tools.

Our in-house simulation framework includes state-of-the-art methods for immersed boundaries, Lagrangian particle and droplet tracking, non-spherical particle dynamics, particle and droplet interactions, gas–liquid interfaces, large-eddy simulation, and fully coupled solvers for compressible and incompressible flows. You will also have the opportunity to establish your own teaching portfolio in areas such as numerical methods, multiphase flows, or particle technology.

*The position is full time for a period of 3 years with the opportunity to extend by a further 3 years.

Job description:

- Develop, implement, and analyse analytical and numerical models for multiphase flows
- Establish an independent research profile in computational multiphase-flow modelling
- Lead and coordinate the further development of our in-house simulation tools in C and MPI
- Develop research ideas and prepare proposals for externally funded research projects
- Supervise PhD researchers, postdoctoral researchers, and students working in computational multiphase flows
- Contribute to teaching in multiphase flows, numerical methods, particle technology, or related subjects
- Contribute to the scientific development and coordination of the computational multiphase-flow group
- Opportunity for further scientific qualification, including the possibility to pursue a Habilitation

Requirements profile:

- A Master’s degree or equivalent and a PhD in mechanical engineering, process engineering, aerospace engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or a related discipline
- A strong background in the physical and numerical modelling of fluid-mechanical or multiphase-flow problems
- Demonstrated research experience in computational multiphase flows, such as particle-laden, droplet-laden, or interfacial flows
- Strong scientific-programming skills in C, C++, or Fortran, including experience with MPI and high-performance computing
- Experience in developing numerical methods or simulation software; expertise in techniques such as immersed-boundary methods, Lagrangian tracking, interface-capturing methods, or particle-interaction models is desirable
- A strong publication record commensurate with your career stage, together with the ability to develop independent research ideas and contribute to research proposals
- Excellent written and spoken English, as well as a good command of German or a commitment to acquiring sufficient German proficiency for teaching and administrative duties within two years

For further information about the position, please contact Prof. Berend van Wachem by email, berend.vanwachem(at)ovgu.de

You will benefit from our structures and offerings in the fields of sustainability, diversity, family support and staff development. Our location in the center of a thriving, lively and family-friendly state capital guarantees a high quality of life and a wide range of leisure activities. For more information, please visit www.ovgu.de/en/karriere (http://www.ovgu.de/en/karriere) .

A Snapshot of Your Day 

Do you want to shape how a global manufacturing network thinks about data, AI, and the cloud? As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) Cloud & AI, you will  work within the Process Digitalization unit, you will design end-to-end solutions on Microsoft Azure and Snowflake that power production, sales, and finance domains alike. Also, you will lead the implementation of AI-driven workflows, e.g. integrating Azure OpenAI, building ML pipelines, and modernizing legacy systems, while also guiding executive leadership on strategic priorities. Every day, you'll balance ambitious architectural thinking with the satisfaction of shipping real, scalable solutions that move the organization toward a truly cloud-native future.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Designing scalable, secure Azure and Snowflake architectures by translating complex requirements from the global manufacturing network into future-proof cloud solutions
* Leading hands-on implementation of cloud and ML solutions by integrating Azure OpenAI into live data workflows and deploying robust CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps
* Driving modernization of legacy systems and automate data flows across production, sales, and finance domains to support a leaner, cloud-native organization
* Acting as a senior thought leader and sparring partner for Azure-based applications, owning the documentation and scaling of architectural designs across the organization
* Communicate architectural strategies and project outcomes clearly to both executive leadership and technical teams, bridging vision and delivery with confidence

What You Bring

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Cloud Engineering, or a related field, paired with many years of experience in cloud architecture
* Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Azure and Snowflake including AI/ML integration, Python, SQL, and API development with a proven track record of delivering production-grade solutions
* Strong strategic planning and influencing skills: you're as comfortable shaping a multi-year architecture roadmap as you are aligning stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), generative AI services, and cloud-based modernization of enterprise systems
* You are business fluent in English; fluency in German is a strong plus

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

For Applicants applying from Austria:

At Siemens Energy we offer competitive compensation and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. Due to the Austrian legal regulations, we are obliged to state the minimum salary for this position. Please note that there is a clear willingness for a higher compensation considering your individual expectations, expertise and skills. The minimum salary for this position in the collective agreement for the electrical and electronics industry is in the amount of 54.439,39 € gross/year for a full-time position (38,5 h/week).
